comment: The invoicing feature is too slow when I have more than 50 clients.
I love how easy it is to send invoices, but I wish there was a mobile app.
Customer support took 3 days to respond to my billing issue.
We need better role-based permissions for our team of 200 people.
The pricing is too high for someone just starting out.
Integration with QuickBooks keeps failing randomly.
The API rate limits are too restrictive for our automated workflows.
I really appreciate the free tier, it helped me get started without risk.
The dashboard is confusing, too many options crammed into one screen.
Invoicing works great but the mobile app is missing entirely.
Onboarding a new team member takes way too long, the process isn't documented well.
Support response time has been really slow lately, over 48 hours.
Would love a mobile app so I can send invoices while traveling.
We need SSO support for enterprise security compliance.
QuickBooks sync broke again this week, very frustrating.
